Stack overflow in the nscd daemon (GLIBC-SA-2026-0016) when a
malicious DNS server returns an oversized response. The vulnerable
code lives only in nscd. libc6 ships the shared C library and does
not include the nscd binary, so the CVE does not apply to it.
https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-89092
